summary: 91/29 has first-person actor suffix -li and reflexive object ruḥi. ʕal u talgo names the snow surface; ʕal gawi specifies belly posture. The crawling interpretation follows from self-dragging and posture without another lexical sense.
The reflexive object preserves active syntax; it is not evidence for Detransitive. Preserve the entry’s existing I stem filing despite the quadriliteral conjugation description.
